SELECT f.file_id AS fileId, (SELECT COALESCE(cu.display_name, ou.display_name) FROM t_file_version cv LEFT JOIN t_file_upload cu ON cu.upload_id = cv.upload_id LEFT JOIN t_file_upload ou ON ou.upload_id = f.upload_id WHERE cv.file_id = f.file_id AND cv.version_no = f.current_version_no) AS displayName, f.source_system AS sourceSystem, f.reason_code AS reasonCode, f.access_level AS accessLevel, f.current_version_no AS currentVersionNo, (SELECT MAX(p.version_no) FROM t_file_version p WHERE p.file_id = f.file_id AND p.version_no > f.current_version_no AND p.version_status = 'CANDIDATE') AS pendingVersionNo, f.scan_status AS scanStatus, f.object_status AS objectStatus, f.mime_type AS mimeType, f.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, f.create_time AS createTime, f.update_time AS updateTime
ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.file_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT f.file_id AS fileId, f.source_system AS sourceSystem, f.reason_code AS reasonCode, COALESCE(cu.display_name, ou.display_name) AS displayName, f.mime_type AS mimeType, f.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, f.content_hash AS contentHash, f.scan_status AS scanStatus, f.object_status AS objectStatus, ou.uploader_id AS uploaderId, f.create_time AS createTime, f.update_time AS updateTime, f.access_level AS accessLevel, f.current_version_no AS currentVersionNo, (SELECT MAX(p.version_no) FROM t_file_version p WHERE p.file_id = f.file_id AND p.version_no > f.current_version_no AND p.version_status = 'CANDIDATE') AS pendingVersionNo, f.storage_provider AS provider, f.storage_container_ref AS container, f.storage_object_ref AS objectRef, b.public_base_url AS publicBaseUrl FROM t_file_object f LEFT JOIN t_file_upload ou ON ou.upload_id = f.upload_id LEFT JOIN t_file_version cv ON cv.file_id = f.file_id AND cv.version_no = f.current_version_no LEFT JOIN t_file_upload cu ON cu.upload_id = cv.upload_id LEFT JOIN t_file_storage_instance i ON i.instance_code = f.storage_provider LEFT JOIN t_file_storage_bucket b ON b.instance_id = i.instance_id AND b.bucket_name = f.storage_container_ref WHERE ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.file_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT v.version_no AS versionNo, v.version_status AS versionStatus, v.scan_status AS scanStatus, u.display_name AS displayName, v.mime_type AS mimeType, v.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, v.content_hash AS contentHash, v.upload_id AS uploadId, u.uploader_id AS uploaderId, v.available_time AS availableTime, v.create_time AS createTime FROM t_file_version v LEFT JOIN t_file_upload u ON u.upload_id = v.upload_id WHERE v.file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC

SELECT s.file_version_no AS versionNo, p.policy_code AS scanPolicyCode, p.revision_no AS revisionNo, r.scanner_code AS scannerCode, r.scan_type AS scanType, s.result_code AS resultCode, s.attempt_no AS attemptNo, s.scanned_time AS scannedTime FROM t_file_scan_result s JOIN t_file_scan_policy p ON p.policy_id = s.scan_policy_id JOIN t_file_scan_requirement r ON r.requirement_id = s.scan_requirement_id WHERE s.file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY s.file_version_no DESC, s.scanned_time DESC, s.scan_result_id DESC

SELECT u.upload_id AS uploadId, u.replaces_file_id AS replacesFileId, u.replacement_no AS replacementNo, u.status, u.display_name AS displayName, u.expected_mime AS expectedMime, u.expected_size AS expectedSize, u.uploader_id AS uploaderId, v.version_no AS resultVersionNo, u.expires_time AS expiresTime, u.create_time AS createTime, u.update_time AS updateTime FROM t_file_upload u LEFT JOIN t_file_version v ON v.upload_id = u.upload_id WHERE u.upload_id = (SELECT f.upload_id FROM t_file_object f WHERE f.file_id = #{fileId}) OR u.replaces_file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY u.replacement_no DESC, u.upload_id DESC
